about: Call for papers for the 2027 Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits, 20-24 June 2027 at Rihga Royal Hotel Kyoto, planned as fully in-person. Three-page papers are submitted through the symposium website by 23:59 JST, January 25, 2027.
